content: Go internal packages: anything under internal/ can only be imported by code rooted at the parent of internal/. This is compiler-enforced. External modules cannot import internal packages. Idiomatic small CLI structure: main.go at root, internal/ for private logic, data/ for embedded assets. Organize internal/ by domain not technical layer. Shallow hierarchies preferred — one or two levels. cmd/ useful only when multiple binaries share a repo; for single-binary tools main.go at root is standard per go.dev/doc/modules/layout.
